source.howDecided: git log c43e9ee1e2..origin/develop over Header.tsx, packages/plugins/i18n/admin/src/components/CMHeaderActions.tsx and both en.json catalogs returns zero commits. Read all four at today's head: Header.tsx lines 719-725 still build the label from id 'content-manager.actions.delete.label' with defaultMessage 'Delete entry{isLocalized, select, true { (all locales)} other {}}', and line 791 still declares position: ['header', 'table-row'] so the same action renders in both the edit-view header and the list-view row menu; CMHeaderActions.tsx lines 655-661 still build 'Delete entry ({locale})' with position: ['header', 'table-row'] at line 654; packages/core/content-manager/admin/src/translations/en.json line 7 and packages/plugins/i18n/admin/src/translations/en.json line 2 carry the same defaults. So today's develop still renders 'Delete entry (all locales)' and 'Delete entry (English (en))', exactly what the two web scenarios observed. Second permalink for the locale-scoped label: https://github.com/strapi/strapi/blob/c7dbadd4feec41f0d3892c1bc9f5435e7aad3672/packages/plugins/i18n/admin/src/components/CMHeaderActions.tsx#L655-L661

reevaluation: The finding stands, unchanged on both sides. The admin UI still renders 'Delete entry (all locales)' and 'Delete entry ({locale})' on today's develop (no commit touched either component or either en.json since the tested build), and strapi/documentation main still instructs the reader to click 'Delete document' and 'Delete locale' at lines 547 and 559, now roughly 23 months after PR #21182 renamed them. Both cited upstream items are in exactly the state the review recorded and neither has had activity since. Nothing changes the verdict (doc-bug), the confidence (high) or the scope. One scope note the filer should carry forward: this is ONE doc bug with two evidenced surfaces, the edit-view header menu (scenario the-edit-view-menu-has-no-delete-document-button.web.1, step 8) and the list-view row menu (the-list-row-menu-has-no-delete-document-button.web.1, step 6), because DeleteAction declares position: ['header', 'table-row'] and renders in both. A single docs issue with both screenshots covers it.
policyBasis: strapi/documentation .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml: 'blank_issues_enabled: false' and the sole contact link 'Strapi Project Issues ... Please use the strapi/strapi repo for these issues' means product bugs go to strapi/strapi and doc-text bugs stay here; file via .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/BUG_REPORT.yml ('Documentation Bug Report', title prefix '[Bug]: ', label 'type: bug'), required fields 'Link to the documentation page or resource' and 'Describe the bug'.
notes: The 'Link to the documentation page' field should be https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/content-manager (Deleting content section). Fix is three spots in one file: line 547 and line 559 ('Delete document' -> 'Delete entry (all locales)', 'Delete locale' -> 'Delete entry (<locale name>)'), plus line 86's 'Delete locale icon' in the list-view bullet list. Mention that without i18n on the content type the ICU 'other' branch renders plain 'Delete entry', which is why the label is conditional. Cite strapi/strapi#20812 and #21182 in the 'Related issue(s)/PR(s)' field as the paper trail for the rename. Caveat unchanged from the review: only the English bundle was inspected, so localized admin translations may still carry the old strings (that would be a separate strapi/strapi issue, not a docs one).
